name: Human Observation Diary
source:
Asakawa Asato has lived his life as a passive, outside observer of the people around him. He keeps an eccentric journal where he has maintained detailed records of his peers, chronicling them in what he describes as 'truly objective reality'.

But he's grown tired of them. He's tired of their mundane lives and simple, noisy platitudes. He's set his eyes on bigger fish: a set of three mildly interesting girls— Nijisawa Natsu, a tomboy with rumours regarding her troublesome family issues, Shiragawa Shizuku, an internet-obsessed loner who seems to be getting bullied by that same tomboy, and Minase Mieko, his stuck up, pampered class president whom Asakawa seems loosely friendly with.

As his 'observation' of these girls continues, Asakawa begins writing down even future observations. These predictions begin to come true, though whether he's gained the powers of foresight or has managed to manipulate reality itself with his texts, he's not quite sure.

[Edited from [url=https://un-brella.itch.io/human-observation-diary]itch.io[/url]]
